reviews.text:
I always love coming back to Martina. Professional, friendly, patient, and putting the dog's well-being first.
If he needs a more thorough wash, more passes with the tools to remove the undercoat, or a few extra stops to calm him down and make him feel comfortable while he's being washed or dried, she'll do it.
Highly recommended!

I'm attaching a photo of my newly groomed baby :D

Terrifying experience! I took my poodle to be washed and trimmed. Not only did she shave him almost completely, but she also cut him under the thigh, leaving a wound a few centimeters long that is still bleeding and required veterinary intervention. He will also need antibiotic therapy. To make matters worse, the operator not only didn't inform me of what had happened, but initially even denied having caused it. So, on top of the incompetence—I asked her to trim his hair and she left only 2 millimeters—there was also the lack of transparency and dishonesty. It seems really excessive to me! Throughout all this, I have not once heard anything like "excuse me" or "I'm sorry." From my experience, I consider this person dangerous.
The perfect person to trust with your dog! Highly recommended!

I took my senior toy poodle to this shop and was completely satisfied! The staff was incredibly kind, patient, and professional, adapting to my puppy's needs with kindness and attention. They handled her age calmly and expertly, making her feel at ease.
Perfect coat, impeccable cut, and a delicious scent!
Martina is very good and knowledgeable, I discovered the shop from their Instagram profile and I'm happy I trusted them!
Martina is a very kind and incredibly professional person! Excellent experience.

We're sorry to hear that your experience wasn't positive. Without specific information, nor the ability to identify the service received or the customer associated with this review, it's difficult for us to verify the content and understand what may have happened.

We remain available to discuss the situation directly with you via our WhatsApp channel to identify any potential issues and continue improving our service.

Expertise, availability, and attention.
Thank you, Martina!

Highly recommended. Martina loves her job, and she loves your dog. She welcomed us, took her time to calm our Mulan, and once she was calm, she bathed her with great care and infinite patience.
We were there the whole time and appreciated her professionalism. Thank you so much, see you soon.

I asked for information via WhatsApp about cleaning my dog's ears, I called several times, but after 5 days the phenomena decided to write to me and tell me that I can easily do it at home with water and salt.
Courtesy, professionalism, excellent value for money
If you want to have your dog groomed, you'll find a skilled, animal-loving person here. They also offer a do-it-yourself service!
